resources.string: Allow access to show your system photos and videos here.
Allow PlainApp to access photos and videos in system settings.
Screen Time or device management restricts photo access. Ask the device administrator to allow it.
PlainApp can only show some of your photos and videos. To show more, allow access in Settings.
Choose a folder to show its music, videos and documents without copying the files.
The folder may have moved or its access may have expired. Choose it again in Files.
Allow PlainApp to manage files in system settings to show images, videos, music and documents.
Allow access to use the feature above. The sharing switch will stay on.
